lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ xiǎng shuō yí jiàn shì.
lines.en: Hello, I want to mention something.

lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 我昨天在这儿买的衣服是坏的。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān zài zhèr mǎi de yīfu shì huài de.
lines.en: The clothes I bought here yesterday are faulty.

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 真的吗？您能让我看看吗？
lines.pinyin: Zhēn de ma? Nín néng ràng wǒ kànkan ma?
lines.en: Really? Can you let me see?

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 对不起，是我们的错。您想换一件吗？
lines.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, shì wǒmen de cuò. Nín xiǎng huàn yí jiàn ma?
lines.en: Sorry, it's our fault. Would you like to exchange it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Dāngrán kěyǐ. Nín yǒu piào ma?
lines.en: Of course. Do you have the receipt?

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 好的，请等一下，我给您换一件新的。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo de, qǐng děng yíxià, wǒ gěi nín huàn yí jiàn xīn de.
lines.en: Okay, one moment, I'll get you a new one.
